verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a workflow for manual, non-automatable evidence: nothing shows owners, due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking on manually uploaded artifacts. The closest item is a note that controls can contain 'evidence, review history, assignments' (oneleet-docs-15). That is control-level assignment, an adjacent feature, and does not cover a recurring renewal or expiry workflow. Fieldwork's scheduled collection (oneleet-docs-16) concerns automated evidence, not manual artifacts.

support.subject: As an operations lead, evidence that can't be automated has a real workflow — owners, due dates, renewal reminders, and expiry tracking on every manual artifact
